title: alxk's blog
subtitle: alxk is a security and platform engineer with a decade in the field. He started the AI cybersecurity evaluations programme at Google DeepMind, which grew to run most of its dangerous capability evaluations. He also threat modelled AI deployments and worked on adversarial testing of image and text watermarking for generative models. Before that, he owned platform and security programmes at two tech scale-ups.
